data.title: Markets News, Aug. 24, 2026: Nasdaq, S&P 500 Close Lower to Begin Week as Chip Stocks Sink; Bitcoin Nears $80,000
data.description: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite finished lower Monday as semiconductor stocks dropped, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average advanced. Meanwhile, crude prices fell as investors took in stride new U.S. sanctions on Iran.
